beats.narration_text: Hello, I'm Vineet S.. A chatbot answers. An A I agent acts. Here is what that means for a product manager.

props.segment: AI Agents Explained for Product Managers
props.command: What is an AI agent, and how is it different from a chatbot?
output: An agent acts, it does not only answer
It calls tools and APIs in a loop
Memory and limits make it safe to use

beats.narration_text: Five ideas. Tools and A P I s. Tool calling. Multi-step reasoning. Memory. And agentic products. Together they turn a model that talks into a system that gets work done.
In tool calling, the model does not run the tool. It requests a call with arguments. Your system runs it. The result goes back to the model. So you decide exactly what the agent can touch.

layers.title: Your system runs it
layers.sub: You control what the agent can touch

layers.title: The result returns
layers.sub: The model reads it and decides next

beats.narration_text: The product manager decides four things. Which tools and permissions. Where a human must approve. How to measure success for the whole task. And step and cost limits, so a loop cannot run away.
